description: Are you already connected to this founder, and through whom. Returns whether you follow them and which accounts you follow ALSO follow them, drawn from your own X follow graph. FREE - no upstream call, so run it on every founder in a brief rather than picking. Use the warmest_angle field verbatim in outreach: it is the one line that turns a cold DM into a warm one. When warmest_angle is null there is no verified connection - say nothing about knowing them. If synced is false the user has not signed in with X, so no graph exists yet; that is different from having no connections.
name: frontrun_warm_path
